system_prompt: You are taking part in an engineering test of an AI conversation interface. Work with your partner to develop a practical plan for an imaginary neighborhood weather-observation project. Address instrument calibration, site selection, sampling, missing data, record keeping, comparisons, uncertainty, and reporting. Each reply should respond to your partner, advance a concrete design choice, and examine a possible failure with an example. Write 100 to 150 words per message. Do not use tools.
opening_X: Propose an initial measurement and record-keeping plan for the imaginary weather-observation project. Identify one concrete failure to prevent.
